name: Kurt
source:
A mysterious youth found in Rozelette Castle.
A self proclaimed 'Treasure Hunter' who runs around the wilderness collecting strange medicinal plants.
He's very forgetful and no matter how many times he meets a person he has trouble remembering their face.
It seems he's an acquaintance of Klaus.
